name: evsc-optional-skills
description: EVSC-reviewed skills staff can choose to install.

plugins.name: plan-first
plugins.description: Before writing or changing code, scripts or formulas, Claude lists what it will change and waits for your go-ahead.

plugins.name: family-communication
plugins.description: Drafts clear, warm messages for parents and guardians: emails, newsletters, notices and replies to concerns.

plugins.name: family-translation
plugins.description: Translates family messages into other languages, keeping names, dates and details exact, with a back-translation to check.

plugins.name: lesson-planner
plugins.description: Plans lessons, units and sub plans around a standard you paste, with timing, checks for understanding and an exit ticket.

plugins.name: differentiate
plugins.description: Adapts texts, directions and tasks for different reading levels, English learners and extension, keeping the same learning goal.

plugins.name: rubric-builder
plugins.description: Builds analytic, single-point and checklist rubrics from your learning goals, with a student-friendly version.

plugins.name: quiz-builder
plugins.description: Writes quizzes, exit tickets and question banks with a separate answer key and mixed difficulty.

plugins.name: feedback-helper
plugins.description: Drafts specific glow-and-grow feedback on de-identified student work against your rubric or success criteria.

plugins.name: meeting-notes
plugins.description: Writes agendas and turns meeting notes into decisions, action items and a short summary.

plugins.name: accessible-docs
plugins.description: Checks documents, slides and emails for accessibility and writes alt text, with fixes for Google Docs and Word.

plugins.name: sheets-formulas
plugins.description: Writes and fixes Google Sheets and Excel formulas from your column layout, with a plain-language explanation.

plugins.name: google-apps-script
plugins.description: Applies Google Apps Script best practices when writing .gs code: the 6-minute limit, triggers, batching and error handling.
